response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with deep experience in developer tools, testing frameworks, and open-source projects, but his resume shows no evidence of people management, team leadership, or direct reports at any point in his 15+ year career. The role explicitly requires 2+ years of people management and 3+ years of technical leadership over a team, none of which is demonstrated here despite his 'Staff' and 'Senior' titles.
strengths: Deep hands-on experience building developer tools, test runners (Trial), and assertion libraries (Fluent-Asserts)
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency systems (DLang, TypeScript, C/C++)
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and mentoring-adjacent activities (Selenium course, Refactoring Dojos)
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct reports anywhere in work history
No mobile-platform-ecosystem experience relevant to the specific focus of this role
Career pattern is consistently IC-focused (Staff/Senior Developer titles) with no manager-track progression

key_factors.factor: No demonstrated technical leadership over a team/org roadmap
Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
